title: 第十三章 林中杀机第十四章 武道奥义
lines: 第十三章：林中杀机
看着一脸吃惊之色的黎凤，黎力也是有些挫败的点了点头。自己一个武师强者，竟然与一个连武者都不是的废物，打了个不相上下。虽然只是简单的交手了一次，并且自己也没有使出全力，但也让黎力深感耻辱。
随即，却见黎力面露喜色的沉声道：“此子实力如此低微，却能与我硬拼一记。那说明他身怀绝技，其使出的那套掌法肯定不简单。而沈彤作为武皇强者，一定教了她那宝贝儿子，什么稀世绝品武技！”。
顿了顿，黎力一脸贪婪的道：“我不仅要杀了那个野种，还要让他交代出那套武技！”。
一想到，自己使用稀世绝品武技大杀四方的场景，黎力那阴沉的脸庞之上，也是闪过一抹笑意。
听到武皇二字，黎凤却是一脸吃惊的道：“什么，沈彤是武皇强者，而不是武王！”。
看了一眼窗外突然下起的小雨，黎力也是一脸阴沉的点了点头，“是尹克西那个老家伙告诉我的，应该没错。难道今天白天，你没看到沈彤拳头之上，形成的凤首罡气虚影吗？罡气化形，可是武皇强者才能使出的！”。
回想今日白天的一幕幕，黎凤也是脸色难看的恨声道：“难怪沈彤一招，能把那武皇老头逼退。原来曾经的天之骄女，是武皇强者了，上天怎会如此不公！”。
随即对着黎力语气冰冷的沉声道：“此事不能出差错，否则计划功亏一篑，我们十几年的心血就都白费了！”。
看了一脸杀气的黎凤，黎力眼眸之中却是闪过一丝疑惑，随后也是沉声答道：“你说的没错，此事不能出一丝差错。以防万一，看来要用上它了。”。
随即只见黎力从宽大的衣袖之中，拿出一拇指大小的黄色小包递给黎凤，并冷声嘱咐道：“这是药皇殿特制的‘引妖粉’，药性极强可吸引一二阶的妖兽，而且其无色无味难以被人发现，你派人将其撒到叶重那野种的衣物之上。”。
接过黎力递过来的药粉，黎凤点了点头沉声道：“我马上派心腹去做！此次一定要成功，杀了那个野种！”。
其心中更是充满恨意的道：“沈彤，这次是的儿子，算是收点利息。下次就是你了，哪怕你是武皇强者，我也要与你不死不休！爹，娘，不孝女儿终于可以替你们报仇了！”。
看着如狸猫般闪身冒雨离去的黎力，依窗而立的黎凤，看着外面淅淅沥沥的春雨，暗自低声自语道：“黎进当初你不惜违背族命，义无反顾的将寒魄珠送给你的心上人，最终弄得自己身死，父母家人惨遭酷刑而亡。你以为她会以此对你心存感激，从而对你心生爱意？但你没想到吧，在你死了之后，她却一走了之，四年之后更是带了一个野种回来。”。
茂林密叶遮掩之下的桃花拗，一片寂静，初晴的烈日阳光都是难以照射进来，地面上更是一片的阴暗潮湿，许多地方还残留着昨夜春雨的积水。
山坳中的桃花花瓣，也是稀疏的铺在了地面之上。白衣少年还是和往常一样，一板一眼的演练着其练习了上万遍的拳法。
“嗯。”，叶重突然眉头一皱，深邃的目光随即向远方眺望而去，口中更是疑惑的低声念叨道：“这桃花坳距离黑龙山脉外围中的最外围猎兽线，都有很长一段距离。日常连普通的野兽都很少见，此次怎么会有如此多的妖兽出现？”。
叶重耳朵微微动了动，听着越来越重的“沙沙”之声，心头也是一紧。叶重虽然没听到那些妖兽的身影，可叶重凭借自己敏锐的听觉和视觉，以及出于对危机感应的本能，他确定自己的猜测并没有错。
“在那！”，叶重低呼一声，随后双眼如鹰鸠般盯着自己右侧的前方。
只见远处的荆棘丛中，渐渐传来愈来愈清晰可闻的沙沙声，并且一个个灰瘦的四蹄身影，也是缓缓显身而出。它们个个模样有点近似于狼，但可个子却要小上一大圈。
那妖兽模样灰瘦灰瘦的，其通体有着密密麻麻的灰色鳞片，一双暗红色眸子，更是带着冰冷的嗜血兽光。迈着四蹄缓缓前行着，它们的眼神只是平静的看着眼前的这名人类。
“灰铁豺？”，叶重看着本只能在书籍之上才看到的物种，却真实的显现在自己眼前，心中也是一紧，但更多的却是一副雀雀欲试的激动。
灰铁豺，一阶妖兽。它们非常冷静且凶狠，擅长配合，而且它们的利爪、尖牙、长齿上都有着剧毒，可轻易致人死命。
何为一阶妖兽？那代表着它们个体实力，都达到了武者之阶！而更恐怖的是，灰铁豺都是形成一个个小族群，一起生活一起猎食。眼前这从荆棘丛中走出来的大一群灰铁豺，足足有四十八头之多，便是单独的一头二阶妖兽被它们遇到，都是会被瞬时撕成碎片的。
叶重深吸一口气，缓缓从储物戒指中拿出那柄泛着冷光的精钢重剑，呼吸也是调整的更加平缓有力，目光死死的盯着眼前这一大群灰铁豺。
这四十八头灰铁豺自然的开始分散，成扇形围着叶重。被这么多灰铁豺的暗红色眼睛同时盯着，叶重也有些心里发紧。叶重的意志虽是了得，剑法也很高，曾经面临过的危机更是不在少数。可这么厉害的对手，叶重还是第一次遇到。
“吼！”，低沉难听的声音，从最后面的一头灰铁豺口中发出。
content_en:
Chapter Thirteen: Murder in the Forest
Looking at Li Feng who looked surprised, Li Li also nodded in frustration. He, a strong martial artist, actually fought on par with a useless person who was not even a martial artist. Although it was just a simple fight and he didn't use his full strength, Li Li felt deeply ashamed.
Immediately, Li Li said in a deep voice with joy on his face: "This boy has such low strength, but he can fight with me head-on. That shows that he has special skills, and the palm techniques he uses are definitely not simple. And Shen Tong, as a strong Martial Emperor, must have taught her precious son some rare and unique martial arts!"
After a pause, Li Li said with a greedy face: "I not only want to kill that bastard, but I also want him to reveal his martial arts skills!".
When he thought of the scene where he used rare and unique martial arts to kill everyone, a smile flashed across Li Li's gloomy face.
Hearing the word Martial Emperor, Li Feng was surprised and said: "What, Shen Tong is a strong Martial Emperor, not a Martial King!".
Glancing at the sudden drizzle outside the window, Li Li nodded gloomily, "That old guy Yin Kexi told me, so he must be right. Didn't you see the phantom of the Phoenix Head's Gang Qi formed on Shen Tong's fist during the day? The Gang Qi can be transformed into a shape, which can only be used by the strong Martial Emperor!"
Recalling the scenes during the day, Li Feng also said with an ugly face and said in a hateful voice: "No wonder Shen Tong was able to force the old man of Emperor Wu back with one move. It turns out that the once proud daughter of heaven is now a strong man of Emperor Wu. How could God be so unfair!".
Then he said to Li Li in a cold and deep voice: "There can be no mistakes in this matter, otherwise the plan will fall short and our more than ten years of hard work will be in vain!".
After looking at Li Feng with a murderous look on his face, Li Li's eyes flashed with doubt, and then he replied in a deep voice: "You are right, there can be no mistakes in this matter. Just in case, it seems that it will be used.".
Immediately, Li Li took out a thumb-sized yellow bag from his wide sleeves and handed it to Li Feng, and said in a cold voice: "This is the 'demon attracting powder' specially made by Yaohuang Palace. It is very powerful and can attract first and second level monsters. It is colorless and odorless and difficult to be discovered. Send someone to sprinkle it on the clothes of that bastard Ye Chong."
Taking the medicinal powder handed over by Li Li, Li Feng nodded and said solemnly: "I will send my confidants to do it right away! This time we must succeed and kill that bastard!".
His heart was full of hatred and he said: "Shen Tong, this time I am my son, so I can collect some interest. Next time it will be you. Even if you are a strong Martial Emperor, I will fight you to death! Father, mother, and unfilial daughter can finally avenge you!"
Seeing Li Li running away in the rain like a civet cat, Li Feng, who was standing by the window, looked at the patter of spring rain outside, and whispered to himself: "Li Jin, you didn't hesitate to violate the clan's fate and gave the Han Soul Pearl to your sweetheart without hesitation. In the end, She had to die, and her parents and family were tortured to death. Do you think she would be grateful to you and love you? But you didn't expect that after you died, she left and brought back a bastard four years later."
The peach blossoms under the cover of dense forest leaves were in silence, and the scorching sunshine of the early clearing sun could hardly shine in. The ground was even darker and damper, with water from last night's spring rain still remaining in many places.
The peach blossom petals in the mountain col are also sparsely spread on the ground. The young man in white was still practicing the boxing techniques he had practiced tens of thousands of times as usual.
"Yeah." Ye Zhong suddenly frowned, and then looked into the distance with his deep eyes, and whispered in confusion: "This Peach Blossom Col is a long way from the outermost hunting line of the Black Dragon Mountain Range. Even ordinary beasts are rarely seen in daily life, so why are there so many monsters appearing this time?"
Ye Zhong's ears twitched slightly, and his heart tightened as he listened to the increasingly loud "rustling" sound. Although Ye Zhong didn't hear the figures of those monster beasts, Ye Zhong relied on his keen hearing and vision, as well as his instinct for crisis sensing, to confirm that his guess was not wrong.
"Over there!" Ye Zhong whispered, then stared at the front on his right side like an eagle dove.
From the thorn bushes in the distance, an increasingly clear and audible rustling sound was gradually heard, and gray and thin figures with four hooves slowly appeared. They all look somewhat similar to wolves, but are much smaller in stature.
The demon beast looked gray and thin, with dense gray scales all over its body, and a pair of dark red eyes with a cold, bloodthirsty beastly light. Moving forward slowly with four hooves, their eyes just looked at the human in front of them calmly.
"Gray iron jackal?" Ye Zhong looked at the species that could only be seen in books, but it actually appeared in front of him. His heart tightened, but more importantly, he was excited to try it.
Gray Iron Jackal, a first-order monster. They are very calm and fierce, good at cooperating, and their claws, fangs, and long teeth are all very poisonous, which can easily kill people.
What is a first-order monster? That means that their individual strength has reached the level of warriors! What's even more terrifying is that the gray iron jackals all form small groups, living together and hunting together. The large group of gray iron jackals that came out of the thorn bushes in front of them totaled forty-eight. Even a single second-level monster that they encountered would be instantly torn into pieces.
Ye Zhong took a deep breath and slowly took out the cold-glow stainless steel heavy sword from the storage ring. He adjusted his breathing to become more gentle and powerful, and stared at the large group of gray iron jackals in front of him.
The forty-eight gray iron jackals naturally began to disperse, forming a fan shape around Ye Zhong. quilt
